Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client_from_json(r#"{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}"#).unwrap();
    let stream = client.chat_stream(req).await.expect("call failed");
    let chunks: Vec<_> = tokio_stream::StreamExt::collect::<Vec<_>>(stream).await
        .into_iter()
        .map(|r| r.expect("stream item failed"))
        .collect();
    println!("{:?}", chunks);
}
```
